instruction: From Karpathy's GPT colab, extract all class definitions (class names and their complete implementations) into a file named "gpt_classes.py" in the Home directory. Include all Python classes found in code cells.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting class definitions from Karpathy's GPT colab. Based on the gold file, expected classes include: BigramLanguageModel, Head, MultiHeadAttention, FeedFoward, Block, and LayerNorm1d. Evaluator checks for presence of at least 4 of these 6 classes (partial credit), with full score if all major classes are present.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses AST parsing to extract Python class definitions from the output file
Checks for the 6 expected classes from Karpathy's GPT colab (BigramLanguageModel, Head, MultiHeadAttention, FeedFoward, Block, LayerNorm1d)
Partial credit logic is reasonable: full proportional score if >= 4 classes found, 50% proportional if < 4
Proper error handling for missing files and syntax errors
get_vm_file getter can successfully fetch the target file from VM path /home/user/gpt_classes.py
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor limitation: evaluator only checks class name existence, not 'complete implementations' as mentioned in instruction - but this is acceptable given complexity of verifying implementation completeness
